Paternal cousin with autism spectrum disorder
outpatient visit, Pediatrics, Dr. Sarah Chen
They report that he has not been speaking as much as his peers and often does not respond to his name. He has a few words in his vocabulary but does not combine them.
outpatient visit, Developmental-Behavioral Pediatrics, Dr. Marcus Johnson

The patient is a 3-year-old male with a history of chronic otitis media who returns for follow-up of behavioral concerns following a January 2020 evaluation for developmental concerns. His parents say he rarely makes eye contact, doesn’t respond to his name, and prefers to play alone.
outpatient visit, Pediatrics, Dr. Sarah Chen
concerns about his eating habits and behavior

This 4-year-old male with a history of chronic otitis media returns for follow-up evaluation of eating habits and behavioral concerns, having presented previously for developmental and behavioral assessments in January and March 2020. His parents report that he has a very limited diet, consisting mainly of white bread, chicken nuggets, and apple juice.
Developmental-Behavioral Pediatrics: Follow-up: development and communication plan (in 3 days)
